description: Tell Godotwright that a godot_review finding was wrong (a false alarm you verified) or right, or whether a lesson from godot_lessons helped. Pass `finding` (the line exactly as godot_review printed it) or `lesson` (its id), not both. For a finding, `verdict` wrong hides it in later reviews on this machine and right counts it as confirmed; a rule marked wrong far more often than right is then reported one level lower. For a lesson, right means it helped and ranks it higher; wrong makes it show up less. Only use it after checking the code (godot_api, godot_check); fix real findings instead of marking them. It writes to the local learning file only (`godotwright learn reset` forgets everything). Returns a one-line confirmation; an error when the line is not a finding, the lesson does not exist, or learning is off.

finding.description: the finding line, e.g. res://player.gd:12: error [api/unknown-member] ...

lesson.description: a lesson id from godot_lessons, e.g. physics/moving-platform-velocity

name: godot_feedback
title: Feedback on a review finding
